provenance.attribution: Chen, D. (2012), Online Retail II, UCI, DOI 10.24432/C5CG6D.
provenance.disjoint_source_identity_audit: passed; source groups and all current sealed cohorts excluded
provenance.eligibility: Qualifying observed purchase in [snapshot-180 days,snapshot-14 days). Snapshot chosen by identity hash among eligible dates, without inspecting targets.
provenance.grouping: CustomerID is indivisible; both-year customers use namespace hash 80/20; one-year eligible customers remain in their available year; training snapshots 2010 and practice 2011.
provenance.limitations: Customer and year shift are combined in practice; calendar batches share seasonal dependence. Historical public source labels are reconstructible, not private. This does not establish prospective model performance.

primary_workbook_coverage.source_row_mapping: one plus sequential data-row index across worksheets; headers excluded

provenance.target_rule: Exact challenge.derive_targets: next 30 days, exact eight-field deduplication, positive purchases only, GBP 2000 cap.
provenance.transformations: Lossless Invoice/Price/Customer ID aliases, integer identifiers as strings, ISO naive dates. Duplicates, returns, nonpositive prices, and missing descriptions retained.
